This implies a potential mechanism where Vancomycin could modulate the inflammatory response associated with Clostridium difficile colitis, potentially reducing the risk of PNEC. The integration of these indications, while not directly establishing a causal relationship, suggests a plausible pathway where Vancomycin might influence the microbiome or inflammatory processes in the gut, thereby mitigating the development of PNEC. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, though further experimental validation is required to confirm the exact role of Vancomycin in this context.
